---
title: "Employment Law"
author: "Eric M. Fink"
version: "5.0"
repo: "EmploymentLaw"
frontispiece: "Der Ackermann"
description: This book presents judicial opinions, statutes and regulations, and other material pertaining to the law governing employment and labor relations. Topics covered include the roots of employment and labor law; establishing an employment relationship; recruitment and hiring; supervisory control and employee autonomy; union representation and concerted activity; confidentiality and competition; wages and hours; employee health and safety; and termination of employment.
epigraph: Workin' 9 to 5, what a way to make a livin'. Barely gettin' by, it's all takin' and no givin'. They just use your mind and they never give you credit. It's enough to drive you crazy if you let it.
epigraph-author: Dolly Parton 
epigraph-source: 9 to 5

format:
  pdf:
    pdf-engine: xelatex
    documentclass: scrbook
    classoption: [letterpaper, 12pt, DIV=9, openright, headings=big]
    has-frontmatter: true
    toc: true
    toc-flat: true
    toc-depth: 4
    toc-title: "Contents"
    number-sections: true
    number-depth: 2
    template-partials:
      - "pdf/partials/before-body.tex"
      - "pdf/partials/after-body.tex"
    include-in-header:
      - "pdf/partials/in-header.tex"
    linkcolor: DarkMidnightBlue
    citecolor: DarkMidnightBlue
    urlcolor: DarkMidnightBlue
    pdftitle: "Employment Law: An Open-Source Casebook"
    pdfauthor: Eric M. Fink
    pdfcreator: LaTeX via pandoc
    colorlinks: true
    urlstyle: tt
    keep-tex: false
    output-file: EmploymentLawCasebook
filters:
  - multibib
  - latex-environment
validate-yaml: false
environments: [legalcode]
commands: [casesection,casesubsection,casesubsubsection]
bibliography: 
  cases: refs/cases.yaml
  statutes: refs/statutes.yaml
  other: refs/other.yaml
csl: refs/indigobook-inline.csl
citation-abbreviations: refs/abbreviations.json
suppress-bibliography: false
citeproc: false
---
